title: Breakaway civilization behind the men at the door

tellings.quote: I think there is a breakaway civilization and we're talking about it right now.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has had his own encounters with non-human beings, tells Michels he believes the men who came to his door were connected to a "breakaway civilization": a hidden group that has split off from ordinary society, with its own secret technology. "I think there is a breakaway civilization and we're talking about it right now," he says, drawing on the ideas of the UFO historian Richard Dolan.
